book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.en: In the morning, Fogg and Aouda reached the harbour.
And Passepartout was not there.
And the Carnatic was not there.
Fogg said to the man at the harbour: the Carnatic?
The man said: she sailed last night.
Ahead of time.
And Fogg did not move.
And Aouda looked at him, and was afraid.

sentences.ar: وفوغ قال: يا سيدتي، الباخرة الجاية بعد أسبوع.
sentences.en: And Fogg said: madam, the next steamer is in a week.
So we find another way.
And Fix was standing beside them.
He pretended to be shocked.
And said: Mr. Fogg!
You missed the steamer too?
And so did I!
What a disaster!
And Fogg looked at him, and said: yes.
And then turned to the harbour.

sentences.ar: ومشى بين المراكب، يسأل كل قبطان.
sentences.en: And walked among the boats, asking every captain.

sentences.ar: ولقى مركب زغير، شراعي، اسمه تانكادير.
sentences.en: And found a small boat, a sailing boat, named the Tankadere.

sentences.ar: وقبطانه جون بونسبي، بحار عجوز، عينه زرقا.
sentences.en: And her captain John Bunsby, an old sailor, with blue eyes.
Fogg said: will you take me to Yokohama?
Bunsby said: Yokohama?
Sixteen hundred miles?
In a boat like this?
No.
Fogg said: to Shanghai, then.

sentences.ar: الباخرة الأمريكية بتمر من شنغهاي يوم 11.
sentences.en: The American steamer calls at Shanghai on the 11th.
Bunsby said: Shanghai, eight hundred miles.
Possible.
But dangerous.
Fogg said: a hundred pounds a day.
And two hundred if we arrive.
Bunsby said: let us go.

sentences.ar: وفوغ لف لفيكس، وقال: بتيجي معنا؟
sentences.en: And Fogg turned to Fix, and said: are you coming with us?
Fix had not expected it.
And said: I... yes. Thank you.
And Passepartout?
Fogg told the police: my servant is lost.
If you find him, send him to Yokohama.
And left money.
And the three boarded the little boat.
And Aouda thinking of Passepartout, weeping in silence.

sentences.ar: وفيكس بيفكر: أنا اللي عملت هيك.
sentences.en: And Fix thinking: I did this.
And now I am on his boat.
What a scoundrel I am.
